title: Modular Topologies on Vector Spaces: Structure and Normability
summary: We investigate the topology generated by modular convergence on vector spaces endowed with a convex modular. Although modular convergence has long played a central role in the theory of modular function spaces, the topology it induces has, to the authors' best knowledge, not previously been studied as an independent mathematical object. Our principal result establishes that the modular topology is compatible with the vector space structure if and only if the underlying modular satisfies the $Δ_2$-condition.
